The exact oil, plant part and route need a check. Do not replace cancer care with an oil based on a root study. Ask before putting new products on skin being treated with radiation.

The 2024 seed study tested throat, cervix and colon cancer cell lines. It also used a non-cancer monkey kidney cell line. No human cancer stage was tested. The separate root paper used colon cells and mice. Neither source gives a matched human stage result for oil.

Did ground root raise liver DNA changes?

Yes, in a rat test. Six rats per group were given plain feed or feed with ground comfrey root for twelve weeks. A liver gene test had about 146 changed copies per million with comfrey and 30 with plain feed. Proof is in Table 1. The test was not of tumor shrinkage or a skin mix.
Read the full ground-root study
What the root test can and cannot answer

The result is a sign of gene harm in rat liver. The result is not a human cancer risk rate. The gene changes fit a plant-poison pathway, but the whole root has many parts. A safe tumor effect of powder with DMSO stays Open.
